primary_goal: Direct observation of Floquet-Bloch replica bands via tr-ARPES
secondary_goal: Elucidate scattering mechanism involving photon-dressed Volkov final states

observables: replica band positions in energy-momentum space
analysis_approach: Compare pump-off and pump-on ARPES spectra
Extract replica band positions from processed data
Fit polarization dependence to cos^2 model
Estimate photon energy from Floquet replica spacing

expected_signatures.floquet_replicas: Bands spaced by integer multiples of photon energy hbar*omega from Dirac cone
expected_signatures.polarization_dependence: Weak modulation consistent with linearly polarized pump coupling
